```{r}
library(A2iSimR, lib.loc = "R_library")
packageVersion("A2iSimR")
```

```{r}
p <- a2i_calibrated_params("HEK293T__joint_condition_primary")
f0 <- a2i_make_features(p, n_transcripts = 4000, n_sites = 10000, seed = 101)
```

```{r}
f <- f0                       # reset FIRST
n_reps       <- 8
strength     <- 1
adar_strength <- 0.5
adar_shift   <- 1
target_depth <- 100
phi          <- 50

# condition effects
for (cond in c("WT_IFNb", "ADAR1KO_mock", "ADAR1KO_IFNb")) {
  col <- paste0("de_logit_shift_condition", cond)
  f$site_info[[col]] <- strength * f0$site_info[[col]]
}

# ADAR modifier
p$design$modifier_effect_mode <- "full"
p$design$adar_sd["ADAR"] <- 1
f$site_info$modifier_active_ADAR <- f$site_info$editable
f$site_info$modifier_slope_ADAR  <- adar_strength * as.numeric(f$site_info$editable)
f$site_info$adar_sensitive       <- f$site_info$editable
p$design$adar_condition_shift[c("WT_mock", "WT_IFNb"), "ADAR"] <- c(0, adar_shift)

# sampling / depth
f$site_info$editing_sampling_model <- "beta_binomial"
f$site_info$precision <- phi
f$transcript_info$baseline_expr <- 1000
f$site_info$site_depth_multiplier <- target_depth / 1000
f$site_info$coverage_fraction <- f$site_info$site_depth_multiplier

p$design$lib_condition_scale[] <- 1
p$design$lib_sdlog <- 0
```

```{r}
sim <- a2i_simulate(p,
  transcript_info = f$transcript_info, site_info = f$site_info,
  n_per_condition = c(WT_mock = n_reps, ADAR1KO_mock = n_reps), seed = 102)

counts <- a2i_long_counts(sim)

# add the per-sample ADAR effect (16 values) to every row of that sample
counts$ADAR_effect_z <- sim$sample_info$ADAR_effect_z[
  match(counts$sample_id, sim$sample_info$sample_id)
]

# keep rows that actually have reads
counts   <- subset(counts,   editable & depth > 0)
counts$condition   <- factor(counts$condition,   levels = c("WT_mock", "ADAR1KO_mock"))


fit1 <- glm(cbind(alt_count, ref_count) ~ condition,
            family = quasibinomial(), data = counts)
fit2 <- glm(cbind(alt_count, ref_count) ~ condition + ADAR_effect_z,
            family = quasibinomial(), data = counts)
summary(fit2)
```


```{r}
summary(sim$site_info$modifier_slope_ADAR)                  # all 0? then the slope was lost
tapply(sim$sample_info$ADAR_effect_z, sim$sample_info$condition, mean)
```

Plotting of the ADAR expression and editing levels of the four conditions 


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#The four condtions 
cond_order <- c("WT_mock", "WT_IFNb", "ADAR1KO_mock", "ADAR1KO_IFNb")

#Simulation with all four conditions
sim4 <- a2i_simulate(p,
                     transcript_info = f$transcript_info, site_info = f$site_info,
                     n_per_condition = setNames(rep(n_reps, 4), cond_order), seed = 102)

#Make the counts
counts4 <- a2i_long_counts(sim4)
counts4$condition <- factor(counts4$condition, levels = cond_order)

```


Per sample summary

```{r}
#editing level per sample = total G reads / total reads over editable sites
ed <- subset(counts4, editable & depth > 0)

sample_edit <- aggregate(cbind(alt_count, depth) ~ sample_id, data = ed, FUN = sum)

sample_edit$editing <- sample_edit$alt_count / sample_edit$depth

samples <- sim4$sample_info[, c("sample_id", "condition", "ADAR", "ADAR_effect_z")]

samples$condition <- factor(samples$condition, levels = cond_order)

samples <- merge(samples, sample_edit[, c("sample_id", "editing")], by = "sample_id")

cond_cols <- c(WT_mock = "#4C72B0", WT_IFNb = "#55A868",
               ADAR1KO_mock = "#C44E52", ADAR1KO_IFNb = "#DD8452", p150KO_mock = "yellow", 
               p150KO_IFNb = "purple")


```


Plotting 

```{r}
p_adar <- ggplot(samples, aes(condition, ADAR, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cond_cols) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Simulated ADAR expression", title = "ADAR expression") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
``` 

```{r}
# ---- Plot 2: global editing level per sample --------------------------------
p_edit <- ggplot(samples, aes(condition, editing * 100, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cond_cols) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Editing level (% G reads, editable sites)",
       title = "Global editing level per sample") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
 
```


```{r}
# ---- Plot 3: per-site editing distribution ----------------------------------
site_level <- subset(ed, depth >= 10)
p_sites <- ggplot(site_level, aes(condition, edit_prop, fill = condition)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cond_cols) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Editing proportion per site (depth >= 10)",
       title = "Site-level editing") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```



```{r}
# ---- Plot 4: ADAR expression vs editing -------------------------------------
p_scatter <- ggplot(samples, aes(ADAR, editing * 100, colour = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cond_cols) +
  labs(x = "Simulated ADAR expression", y = "Editing level (%)",
       colour = NULL, title = "ADAR expression vs editing") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
```

```{r}
get_row <- function(name, fit1, fit2) {
  c1 <- coef(summary(fit1)); c2 <- coef(summary(fit2))
  cond <- grep("^condition", rownames(c1), value = TRUE)
  data.frame(comparison       = name,
             coefficient      = cond,
             beta1_cond_only  = c1[cond, "Estimate"],
             p_beta1_cond_only = c1[cond, "Pr(>|t|)"],
             beta1_with_ADAR  = c2[cond, "Estimate"],
             p_beta1_with_ADAR = c2[cond, "Pr(>|t|)"],
             beta2_ADAR       = c2["ADAR_effect_z", "Estimate"],
             se_beta2         = c2["ADAR_effect_z", "Std. Error"],
             p_beta2          = c2["ADAR_effect_z", "Pr(>|t|)"],
             dispersion       = summary(fit2)$dispersion)
}

res <- rbind(get_row("WT_mock vs ADAR1KO_mock", fit1,   fit2),
             get_row("WT_IFNb vs ADAR1KO_IFNb", fit1_2, fit2_2),
             get_row("WT_mock vs WT_IFNb",      fit1_3, fit2_3))
print(res, digits = 3)
```
